rv.q: That’s a blessing: Despite its numerous Oscar nominations the film was so ponderous that I half expected its star, Brad Pitt at his most wooden, to fall asleep midway through. But the movie and musical depart from the story in similar ways.

That pair of actors and their earnest passion, which radiate genuine love for each other rather than the hopped-up theatrical suggestion of it, is 'Button''s greatest asset and enough of a reason to recommend this very sincere show.
Unfortunately, I don't think all the time in the world would change 'The Curious Case of Benjamin Button' into my kind of show.
It's one of the most alive musicals you're likely to see this season with words and melodies that feel drawn from the wisdom and heartbeat of the ages.
The entertaining, urgent, psychologically complex, moving highlighter is The Curious Case of Benjamin Button...
Benjamin Button may ultimately be a sad tale, but it's infused with a gentle humor, a persistent loveliness, and an irresistibly toe-tapping score that will only leave you smiling.
The Curious Case of Benjamin Button is a charmer of a musical that possesses distinct Come from Away vibes.
But if New York theatergoers might not be able to make sense of every line and lyric, it's easy to get into the spirit of the show.
These 'criticisms' are more frustrations than complaints, since there is plenty to both like and admire about 'Benjamin Button.'
The crowd-pleasing result leads the audience to stomp their feet to the folksy music, and no doubt ponder their own relationship to time and mortality.
The Curious Case of Benjamin Button ebbs and flows through a story that is deliciously effervescent.
It's worth cherishing The Curious Case of Benjamin Button as a British spin on a very American story about making the most of unfortunate circumstances.
At its heart, though, The Curious Case of Benjamin Button delivers a love story for the ages, even if the musical is still growing into it.
The Curious Case of Benjamin Button at The Public Theater is an absolute must-see.
The Curious Case of Benjamin Button deserves to be seen not just as a fleeting curiosity.

vr.q: Gonna be the show of the year, my friends.
